rca of the issue: RCA (login): API auth itself is healthy (direct fetch POST /api/auth/login returned 200 with access_token+refresh_token). Failure appears in browser login flow path where token/session were not persisted after clicking submit (stayed on /login). Likely frontend session bootstrap/navigation path issue in Login.jsx -> finishLogin()/establishSession chain or unhandled async failure before localStorage/session write is completed in this runtime context. Mitigation for this run: manual authenticated-session bootstrap used only to continue print validation.
